approvalEvidence: Lucas approved the Gift-Thread style for all items, products, and articles and authorized deployment on 2026-08-23.

assets.alt: A golfer cleans club grooves beside a golf bag with a towel, rain glove, umbrella, and putting gate linked by a saffron ribbon.
assets.caption: The strongest golf gifts solve a small course-day annoyance the recipient already works around.
assets.promptSummary: An adult golfer addresses observed groove-cleaning, towel, rain, and putting-practice frictions with generic category objects connected by the Gift-Thread ribbon.

assets.alt: An editor compares product cards, a source ledger, a drawback flag, and a recipient clue before choosing a gift.
assets.caption: A recipient clue becomes a recommendation only after sources, drawbacks, and product identity survive review.
assets.promptSummary: A rigorous gift editor moves from recipient clue through candidate comparison, source checking, drawback review, and recommendation.

assets.alt: A knitter places a work in progress in a project case while holding a row counter beside an abstract magnetic chart.
assets.caption: A useful fiber-art pair protects the maker's place so the next session starts with less reconstruction.
assets.promptSummary: One adult maker uses a structured project case, mechanical row counter, and abstract magnetic chart in a mark-close-resume loop.

assets.alt: A language learner reads an illustrated scene aloud and arranges picture cards to retell it in their own words.
assets.caption: The pair works when a short scene becomes a low-pressure speaking prompt rather than another passive study item.
assets.promptSummary: An adult learner reads a picture-led dialogue aloud and uses three original story cards to retell the scene.

assets.alt: A miniature painter matches wet-palette paint mixes to color swatches in a recipe notebook beside a generic figure.
assets.caption: The wet palette preserves the current session; the recipe notebook preserves the mix for the next one.
assets.promptSummary: An adult miniature painter connects a reusable wet palette, physical color-recipe swatches, and an original generic figure.

assets.alt: A dog owner calmly rinses one muddy paw in an entryway with a large drying towel ready beside them.
assets.caption: The thoughtful gift is the repeatable arrival routine: stable rinse, complete dry, and an easier clean-floor reset.
assets.promptSummary: One adult and a relaxed dog demonstrate a stable manual paw-rinse and towel-dry entryway routine with generic objects.

assets.alt: A neighborhood walker compares a fallen leaf and twig with a field guide and hand loupe beside a street tree.
assets.caption: One tree, one walk, one careful observation turns two small tools into an ongoing neighborhood ritual.
assets.promptSummary: An adult walker uses a regional field guide and 10x loupe to examine one fallen leaf and twig without asserting a species.

assets.alt: A backyard observer uses a rotating star chart and dim red flashlight to trace one constellation in a dark sky.
assets.caption: The pairing works when the chart narrows the search and the dim red light helps the observer stay with the sky.
assets.promptSummary: One adult uses a generic latitude-matched planisphere and dim red light to find a single abstract constellation safely outdoors.

assets.alt: Two generations share one anonymous family photo while one person records the story beside blank cards and an archival sleeve.
assets.caption: One protected photo and one recorded story make the gift a shared act, not an empty album assignment.
assets.promptSummary: Two adults of different generations protect an anonymous vintage photo, talk, and record one memory on a blank card.

assets.alt: A puzzler slides a partly completed landscape puzzle into a portable board beside several color-sorting trays.
assets.caption: The board protects the in-progress picture; the trays protect the next session from a long restart.
assets.promptSummary: One adult saves a generic jigsaw in a zippered board, sorts pieces into shallow trays, and reclaims the dining table.

assets.alt: A reader moves between an open history book and a laptop showing an original hexagonal world map, joined by a saffron ribbon.
assets.caption: The pair works when reading creates questions the recipient wants to test in a strategy game—and the game sends them back with better questions.
assets.promptSummary: One adult moves between a generic big-history book and an original hex-map computer strategy scene linked by a saffron ribbon.

assets.alt: A reader connects a bird-cognition book, an original habitat engine on a laptop, and a bird observed through the window.
assets.caption: Read one cognition story, notice how a game abstracts it, then look for the behavior outdoors.
assets.promptSummary: An adult connects a generic bird-cognition book, original digital habitat engine, and neighborhood observation.

assets.alt: A reader compares settlement constraints in a Mars book with an original card-focused engine tableau and resource cubes.
assets.caption: The book supplies the constraint; the tabletop model makes its omissions and optimistic shortcuts discussable.
assets.promptSummary: An adult compares a skeptical generic Mars-settlement book with an original card-focused engine tableau that avoids Ares Expedition trade dress.

assets.alt: A reader draws a feedback loop beside a systems book and an original cooperative network board game.
assets.caption: Name the stock, flow, delay, and loop after play so the game becomes a discussion rather than a literal model.
assets.promptSummary: An adult links abstract systems diagrams with an original cooperative town-network board game and draws one loop.

assets.alt: Four friends connect a book of speech-bubble diagrams with a word-association game represented by blank line cards.
assets.caption: A clue succeeds because of the particular people at the table—the same context the book helps them notice.
assets.promptSummary: Four adults connect abstract internet-language concepts with an original word-association game represented by blank line cards rather than Codenames art.

assets.alt: A reader links a parks memoir, an original route game, and a landscape photo that could prompt a real outing.
assets.caption: The useful ending is not a winning score—it is one saved trail, scheduled outing, or remembered photo.
assets.promptSummary: An adult turns a generic park memoir and original route game into one future trail or revisited landscape photo.

assets.alt: A writer pairs a craft book with exactly nine original picture-prompt cubes and begins a timed handwritten draft.
assets.caption: The book sets the craft objective; the cubes supply only enough constraint to help the pencil move.
assets.promptSummary: An adult combines a generic prose-craft book, exactly nine countable original picture cubes, a blank timer, and a handwritten draft.

assets.alt: A photographer holds a picture-led technique guide while framing an architectural reflection after rain.
assets.caption: One principle and one safe assignment turn a guide into a short practice-and-review loop.
assets.promptSummary: One adult uses a generic technique guide, picture-only reflection assignment, and existing camera on a respectful photo walk.

assets.alt: A reader traces roots and exchange paths between a fungal ecology book and an original forest network game.
assets.caption: The book supplies the living-system story; the game invites the recipient to name what its neat network leaves out.
assets.promptSummary: An adult links a generic fungal-ecology book with an original tabletop forest network of trees, roots, and resource stones.

assets.alt: A home cook safely uses a compact blank-display folding probe thermometer beside a picture-led cooking science reference.
assets.caption: The reference explains the heat; the thermometer turns that concept into one careful observation.
assets.promptSummary: One adult home cook safely connects an abstract cooking-science reference, a self-contained compact folding probe thermometer with no wire, and a blank note card.

assets.alt: An adult holds a flashlight and precision bit set among a packing cube, thermometer, mouse, and loose hinge.
assets.caption: A useful gift earns its space by solving one friction the recipient already tolerates.
assets.promptSummary: One adult considers five generic small-friction tools: packing cube, blank thermometer, quiet mouse, flashlight, and bit set.

assets.alt: Two hands safely clean a generic record by its edge and grooves beside a drying rack and plain inner sleeves.
assets.caption: The pair is useful when it creates a repeatable clean, fully dry, resleeve, and archive reset.
assets.promptSummary: Exactly two hands keep fingers on the record edge and the brush on grooves outside a center label protector while a second record dries.
